The Chinese characters for Joseph

As a transliteration, Joseph is usually written 约瑟夫 (Yuē sè fū). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

约
Yuē
pact, about
瑟
sè
a zither (transliteration)
夫
fū
man, husband

Origin and meaning

From Hebrew, Joseph carries the meaning “God will add”.

About the name Joseph

In the Bible, Joseph was sold into slavery by his brothers but rose to save Egypt.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Joseph suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
